Remark
[Divergence of the curvature tensor]

Source: petersen:page-0122 ↗ prop:pet-ch3-contracted-bianchi ↗ notation:pet-ch3-divergence-adjoint

1. ch3:3.4.8With $R$ the $(0,4)$-curvature tensor and $\operatorname {Ric}$ the $(0,2)$-Ricci tensor, show $( abla ^*R)(Z,X,Y)=( abla _X\operatorname {Ric})(Y,Z)-( abla _Y\operatorname {Ric})(X,Z)$. Conclude $ abla ^*R=0$ if $ abla \operatorname {Ric}=0$, and that $ abla ^*R=0$ iff the $(1,1)$-Ricci tensor satisfies $( abla _X\operatorname {Ric})(Y)=( abla _Y\operatorname {Ric})(X)$ for all $X,Y$.
